title: Telos: A Dataflow Accelerator for Sparse Triangular Solver of Partial Differential Equations
problem: Sparse triangular solve (SpTRSV) dominates runtime in preconditioned iterative solvers for PDE-derived linear systems due to loop-carried dependencies that severely limit parallelism. Prior accelerators cannot simultaneously achieve high parallelism and good data locality for structured sparsity from stencil-based PDE discretizations.
motivation: SpTRSV is the critical bottleneck in scientific PDE solvers, and structured stencil-based sparsity patterns offer exploitable regularity that generic sparse solvers ignore.
method: Telos is a specialized chip that exploits regular grid-pattern sparsity in sparse triangular solvers. It divides the problem into parallel "planes" (slices of computation) mapped across processing elements, with each plane keeping its data local to avoid slow memory access. Communication between planes is reorganized into synchronized pipeline flows (systolic flows), allowing dependent computations to execute as soon as their inputs arrive with minimal waiting. The chip overlaps computation with memory fetches to hide data-access delays.
key_novelty: Plane-parallel pipelining—breaking computation into parallel planes with synchronized data flow between them—that resolves loop-carried dependencies while preserving data locality by exploiting the regular grid patterns in PDE-derived sparsity.
contributions: Identification and exploitation of structured (stencil-pattern) sparsity to extract pipeline parallelism in SpTRSV.
Plane-parallel pipelining technique that maps dependent computations onto PEs while preserving data locality.
Cross-plane communication aggregation to streamline data transfers into a systolic execution pattern.
Demonstrated speedups of 61x over CPU, 8x over GPU, and 11x over state-of-the-art accelerator.

metrics.speedup: 61x over CPU, 8x over GPU, 11x over state-of-the-art accelerator

limitations: Evaluation targets stencil-based PDE sparsity patterns; applicability to irregular or non-stencil sparse structures is not demonstrated.
primary_theme: Dataflow acceleration of sparse triangular solve for PDE workloads
